name: silverbullet-local
description: Read, search and (optionally) edit your SilverBullet space from Claude, through a local MCP server that talks to SilverBullet's HTTP API.

sb_url.title: SilverBullet URL
sb_url.description: Base URL of your SilverBullet space, e.g. http://localhost:3000

sb_token.title: SilverBullet token
sb_token.description: Value of SB_AUTH_TOKEN on your SilverBullet server. Leave empty if authentication is disabled.

sb_allow_write.title: Allow writing
sb_allow_write.description: Enable the write_page and append_to_page tools
